item.title: 253 health goals you can act on
item.summary: Browse practical, research-backed guides for outcomes like sleeping better, lowering resting heart rate, building strength, and training for an event.
item.details: Every guide works on its own. If you want help carrying it out, the Murph action opens an editable draft in your messaging app; nothing is sent or saved until you choose to send and later approve a plan.
